text:
For a **European hotel conversion where the owner wants to retain the property’s name, design and operating personality**, the usual long list includes:

### Major chain-affiliated soft brands

- **Marriott:** **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** and, for luxury properties, **The Luxury Collection**. **Design Hotels** is a more selective, design-led affiliation; only certain members participate fully in Marriott Bonvoy. **Series by Marriott** can also suit an existing regional brand or multi-property portfolio. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai))
- **Hilton:** **Curio Collection** for upper-upscale/luxury hotels, **Tapestry Collection** for more accessible upscale conversions, and **LXR Hotels & Resorts** at the luxury end. Hilton expressly positions its collection brands as flexible frameworks for independent properties. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/corporate-news/qa-kevin-jacobs-on-7000-hotels-continued-growth-and-more-milestones?trk=public_post-text&utm_source=openai))
- **IHG:** **Vignette Collection**, particularly for distinctive luxury and upper-upscale hotels. **voco** is frequently considered alongside it because it is highly conversion-oriented, although voco is more of a flexible core brand than a true soft brand. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-resorts-debuts-9-brands-in-13-countries-across-europe?utm_source=openai))
- **Accor:** **Emblems Collection** for luxury, **MGallery** for upper-upscale/luxury boutique properties, and **Handwritten Collection** for midscale-to-upscale independent hotels. Accor specifically prioritizes conversions for these collection brands. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt:** **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** for upper-upscale/luxury properties and **JdV by Hyatt** for lifestyle and neighborhood-led hotels. **Destination by Hyatt** is relevant mainly to resort-led assets. The newer **Unscripted by Hyatt** is designed as a flexible upscale collection but has a less established European track record. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/en-US/brands/hyatt-independent-collections?utm_source=openai))
- **Radisson Hotel Group:** **Radisson Individuals** is one of the most directly conversion-focused European options, allowing a hotel to retain its identity with comparatively limited capital intervention. **Radisson Collection** can be considered for higher-end landmark properties, although it normally carries a stronger brand overlay. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai))
- **Wyndham:** **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**, generally aimed at upper-midscale and upscale independent hotels seeking Wyndham distribution without adopting a conventional hard-brand identity. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/Trademark-One-Sheet.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **Choice Hotels:** **Ascend Hotel Collection**, an upscale soft brand emphasizing minimal design and amenity constraints. Its relevance varies by European country and the strength of Choice’s local platform. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai))
- **BWH Hotels:** **BW Signature Collection**, **BW Premier Collection**, and the **WorldHotels** collections—Luxury, Elite, Distinctive and Crafted. These can be attractive where independence and lower conversion disruption matter more than access to one of the largest global loyalty ecosystems. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/bwpremier?utm_source=openai))

### Lighter-touch representation affiliations

Where the owner wants more independence than a franchise-style soft brand normally provides, the comparison set often includes:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World**
- **Design Hotels**
- **WorldHotels**, depending on the contractual structure and collection

These typically emphasize sales, marketing, distribution and quality affiliation rather than a conventional chain operating identity. Preferred and SLH explicitly market themselves to owners wishing to preserve independence. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))

### Typical shortlist by positioning

| Property positioning | Common candidates |
|---|---|
| **Luxury/iconic** | Luxury Collection, LXR, Vignette, Unbound, Emblems, MGallery, Radisson Collection, WorldHotels Luxury, Preferred, SLH |
| **Upper-upscale boutique/lifestyle** | Autograph, Curio, Tribute, JdV, MGallery, Radisson Individuals, WorldHotels Elite/Crafted |
| **Upscale independent** | Tapestry, Handwritten, Radisson Individuals, Trademark, Ascend, BW Premier Collection |
| **Midscale or regional portfolio** | Handwritten, BW Signature Collection, Series by Marriott, selected Trademark or Ascend opportunities |

The key caveat is that **“soft” does not mean standards-free**. Owners should compare required property-improvement plans, mandatory systems, loyalty and reservation charges, naming rights, operating standards, contract term, termination rights, territorial protection and total fee load. A representation affiliation normally preserves more autonomy; a major-chain soft brand usually offers a stronger loyalty and distribution engine but imposes more standards and integration requirements.
